recording.instructions: Play the melody Honks. Keep Trigger held through the connected lower phrases and sustained bends. Release and press for each new indicated note. The Loopers play the tabla-inspired percussion backing. Either hand works.

arrangement.title: Honk with tabla-inspired backing
arrangement.provenance: Sequence 01 harmonium reference, rendition 5: original timing at a 68 BPM editing grid, 150 melodic pitch targets in 59 holds, connected lower phrases from 29.211 to 41.204 seconds, expressive closing bends, and 225 native Boink/wood strokes. Approved revision: the 70 ms D3 at 46.933 seconds becomes a three-semitone downward-and-back ornament inside one D4 hold (h045–h047).

lessons.title: Opening and first turns
lessons.goal: Keep the repeated pulses distinct and hold through the bends. The Loopers play the tabla-inspired backing.

lessons.title: Upper answer and return
lessons.goal: Follow the upper turns and ease back down with the melody. The Loopers play the tabla-inspired backing.

lessons.title: Connected lower descent
lessons.goal: Keep Trigger held through the long low phrase. Follow the rises, dips and recovery without re-pressing. The Loopers play the tabla-inspired backing.

lessons.title: Low answer and return
lessons.goal: Connect the descending answer and sustain the low note as it gently rises and falls. The Loopers play the tabla-inspired backing.

lessons.title: Build into the upper phrase
lessons.goal: Follow the new presses through the rising phrase. The Loopers play the tabla-inspired backing.

lessons.title: Upper response
lessons.goal: Keep the upper notes clear and hold through each bend. The Loopers play the tabla-inspired backing.

lessons.title: Expressive closing phrases
lessons.goal: Follow the deeper bends and keep the sustained phrases connected. The Loopers play the tabla-inspired backing.

lessons.title: Final bends
lessons.goal: Hold through the final turns and release at the end. The Loopers play the tabla-inspired backing.

lessons.title: Complete guided performance
lessons.goal: Play the melody at 68 BPM while the Loopers play the tabla-inspired backing. Hold Trigger through every connected bend, including the lower passage and closing sustains. Release between separate presses. Either hand works.
